notes.title: Road to Chapter 2 - Part 8: Playtest Summary
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/2f0fed8bf876825524ecc970bb55dcfb7364855b.png[/img]

Hey Warlocks! 

The road to Chapter 2 continues, and we are back to share another update on the preparation for its release. Our team is analyzing the feedback shared by a group of players who had a chance to test Urd’s adventure in its entirety. 

First-hand impressions gathered from players in the last phase of development will help us polish the overall experience when it comes to weapon performance, spell casting, enemy behavior, level design, character progression and more. 

Let’s break it down in our playtest summary!

[h3][b]CHAPTER 2 - COMMUNITY IMPRESSIONS
[/b][/h3]

During 4 days of playtesting all of the 12 levels of Chapter 2 you shared over 1200 comments on various aspects of the game. Below, you can learn more about how it relates to the main pillars of Chapter 2 of Project Warlock II. 

[h3][b]Weapons[/b][/h3]

As the Project Warlock community was always very perceptive about different aspects of weaponry we decided to let our playtesters try out the full arsenal available for fiery Urd. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/4ce966eab2f09d5f9f884f0867c5b19f379d87ff.gif[/img]

Some of you pointed out that certain weapons feel weak without any perks, but they may be overpowered when fully upgraded. Right now our goal is to put additional work into balancing this aspect of the combat system. Among a few other changes, we plan to buff the base version of Scoped Pistol, reduce the ammo capacity of SMG, or introduce more variants of the grenade via Wargression upgrades.

We also received feedback regarding Urd’s dagger. “Dagger Dash” skill will be redesigned and now it will only work if grounded. We also want to reduce the time of the blade throws with an additional upgrade and enhance the visual effects of “Dagger Storm”.
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Magic[/b][/h3]

Urd is a magic caster first, and gun user second which is reflected in her arsenal and separates her toolset from that of the more trigger happy Palmer. Your experience with a full set of magic abilities in Chapter 2 helped us list a few areas requiring some changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/e6b89b696d98cd50aeaf89bf8853102ee4aad3e7.gif[/img]

Utilizing Spell Book on the battlefield can make a huge difference and we’ve put a lot of effort into making it as satisfying to use as possible. Some of the changes will be focusing on the animations, cooldowns of spell casting, or in general, the performance of certain spell types.

We would like to also address your suggestions regarding the Crystal Sentry. Changes that we plan to implement relate to its spawning and targeting enemies. In addition, we want to disable friendly fire against our magical companion and improve its pathing. 

We also plan to boost Urd’s witchcraft a lot to make it more appealing to use. Area of Effect and damage outputs will all be buffed to a point where magic feels really powerful to use.
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Wargression & Skills[/b][/h3]

Our team is also working on improving the Wargression system based on the information collected from our Discord. Many playtesters didn’t stop on a single playthrough which helped us learn more about different outcomes for upgrade categories or effectiveness of perk parameters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/3c22bc6c9f583e76330a5c1e774428a549b8afbc.gif[/img]

Our aim is to tweak certain perks in terms of additional damage, duration of upgrade effects or the frequency of accessing particular types of upgrades. Based on your experience with the Luck perks and Token rerolls, we decided to change its basic rules to provide reasonable proportions in using this system. 

More changes we consider for character progression relate to the way of acquiring upgrade tokens or even implementing the new perk category.
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Locations[/b][/h3]

Our playtests let all the participants visit the whole 12 levels of the treacherous brutalist west. Giving you a chance to lurk in every nook and cranny of each location in Chapter 2 allowed us to plan more improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/75160920c341e48cce9b001c3185e7903b11f67c.gif[/img]

First of all, we were able to learn more about your reactions when it comes to navigating the Chapter 2 levels. Based on your comments, we can put some final touches to the overall guidance of the player through the different segments of the game’s locations. 

We also received a lot of feedback regarding enemy spawn placements and overall amount of monsters wandering about in given areas of maps. Let’s just say repopulation of certain areas seems in order with the aim to serve you a stronger adrenaline rush where it's too quiet, or give you a little bit more space where it feels right to do so.
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Enemies[/b][/h3]

Killing hordes of terrifying foes is Warlocks’ bread and butter so we need to make sure that your encounters with all sorts of deadly creatures are satisfying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/5ee8bf3e4c2f37b3f6e30307c2c5741073eb695e.gif[/img]

The overall reception of the enemies of Chapter 2 was very positive. Our team put a lot of effort into creating an extensive roster of grotesque foes and we can clearly see that it was appreciated by players. 

Many of our playtesters took their time and effort to share with us the information about the reactions of enemies in particular situations and performance of certain weapons against a given type of foes. Feedback we received led us to plan changes such as additional animations for dodging (Demonface), the priority of the weapon chosen for the attack (Elf Shaman), damage dealt by special attacks (Vamps), amount of health points (Turboshambler), and more. 

Most importantly Wraith and Demonface will be adjusted, where Wraith's resistances will be more visually represented, and their behavior will be unique among other monsters - they will be the only monsters to have the possibility to move and attack simultaneously. Also, Wraith will be nerfed when it comes to his attack interval and damage output.

Another crucial point, which the playtester raised are boss fights. We’ll be thinking of ways to make sure you have the most fun possible during those encounters and we’ll be taking another look to see what we can do about the bosses placement on the levels as well as their healthpools and overall difficulty.
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]TILL NEXT TIME![/b][/h3]

That’s all for today’s entry on Chapter 2. Our team will be now working hard on implementing various changes based on playtesters impressions in order to polish game systems and deliver a thrilling experience on the release. 

Also - please keep in mind that the Chapter 2 demo is available to play on Steam and GOG and your feedback is always appreciated.

See you in the next update!
[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Road to Chapter 2: Part 5 - Playtests on the horizon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/4d701fbdf824a1c8034c7a374fae1d6ec7931e18.png[/img]

Hey Warlocks! 

Last week was very busy for the team and a lot happened in the Warlock world.  

[b]First of all we released the demo of the upcoming Chapter 2 [/b]and we are very happy with your reception. What’s more, the weekend brought us brand new materials showcasing the mentioned chapter as well as a new announcement that expands the Project Warlock Universe! 

Thank you very much for all your comments and feedback over the last week, and we collated the most pressing ones and would like to answer them for everyone to see. 

We would also like to wrap up the latest events as well as share with you what is coming next. 

So, let’s get to it!

[h2][b]ANSWERING COMMUNITY QUESTIONS!  [/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/06561e28f3c42a62fd16f67b80b8a01e7ff3f37e.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Chapter 2 general FAQ[/b][/h3]

[b]Q: What exactly are the chapters and what are the levels?[/b]

A; Chapters are parts of the game containing stories of different playable characters 
[list]
[*] Chapter 1 (featuring Palmer) is available now in the Early Access version of the game. 
[*] Chapter 2 (featuring Urd) will be out soon. 
[*] Chapter 3 (featuring Kirsten) will be developed and released after Chapter 2. [/list]
Each chapter contains 12 levels - which means 12 different locations to battle evil minions in. 

[b]Q: If I play Palmer, will I have the same Wargression system or Hub?
[/b]A: Chapter 1 with Palmer as playable character retains certain aspects of the first Project Warlock game - with HUB serving as a place to upgrade weapons, skills and stats. Chapter 2 has the dynamic Wargression system implemented specifically for Urd. We’re constantly looking at feedback regarding both of these systems, and after launching Chapter 2 will see what you guys think to find the best way to enjoy the game.  

[b]Q: Will Chapter 1&2 force you to play specific characters ro will you be able to play as any character?
[/b]A: At the moment the game lets you play a specific character in the given chapter but we would like to make sure you can have more freedom in choosing the character to tackle each of the chapters. 

[b]Q: Is there any ability unlocks in the level? Didn't see any. (Like character ability, not the wargression ones). Same thing with weapon upgrades).[/b]
A: At the moment the Chapter 2’s Level 1 presented in the demo is tailored to showcase certain elements of the game on top of the new progression system. It is tailored to give the player a bit more things to experiment with. As to the spells - those are unlockable in the following levels.

[b]Q: Dagger with its Wargression stuff feels too OP. Would this balance out in later levels? [/b]
A: We are still tweaking the balance of the game so based on your feedback we will look into this case as well. We have a couple of ideas on how to make sure the dagger’s melee attack is as fun as the projectile one. 

[b]Q: Is there any reason to replay the demo?[/b]
A: We definitely recommend replaying the first level - Wargression, the new progression system is designed to make each run different. By replaying the demo level you can check out various upgrade combos and try them out before Chapter 2 comes out.

[b]Q: I don't think there is any way to see currently which powers/upgrades I have chosen and currently possess.[/b]
A: You can see your current upgrades in the Status menu which can be activated by pressing TAB. 

[b]Q: Quick save isn't working in the demo[/b]
A: The quick-save option was not implemented into the demo version to make sure you can complete this in one go. Cloud saves are also disabled.


[h2][b]CHAPTER 2 PLAYTESTS![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/aa7f3b38dc1a72a15b649bb974035b31c56aeec2.jpg[/img]

It’s very important for us to make sure you have a chance to influence the game before it is released so we will be starting the Chapter 2 community playtests before its eventual release! 

[b]Chapter 2 playtests will launch next week and will let you play through all the 12 levels of Urd’s adventure.  [/b]

How to sign up for Chapter 2 Playtests? Easy. Just join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/Nx6CmMNgrj]Discord server[/url] and head to the [b]“Playtest Club”[/b] channel for more information - it’s the second channel on the list.

[h2][b]FEEDBACK LIVES AGAIN! [/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/7fc15e4d97a9d84e18e3431e7e1ccea4de7d5e0d.jpg[/img]

Did we already mention that your feedback is very welcome? Well, it wouldn't hurt to say that again. If you had a chance to play the Chapter 2 demo (available both for the owners of the game, and those still holding off) please consider sharing your thoughts on game forums as well as on our community Discord.

In case you have any questions regarding the installation of Chapter 2 demo, please check [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1640300/Project_Warlock_II/]our last post[/url] which containing step by step instructions on how to do it! 

[h2][b]NEW CHAPTER 2 TRAILER FROM REALMS DEEP 2023! [/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=2lhNaG9NQ4M;full][/previewyoutube]

And now for a short trip down the memory lane. Going back as far as last weekend. Saturday to be exact. On that fateful day Realms Deep 2023 showcase hosted a bunch of cool games, reveals and surprises, including Project Warlock 2’s Red Head Redemption trailer! See it here.

We also announced Project Warlock: Lost Chapters that will be arriving after Project Warlock 2 leaves Early Access. You can check it out here. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1043850/Project_Warlock_Lost_Chapters/

[b]SEE YOU NEXT WEEK! [/b]

That is all for today’s update!

We can’t wait to hear what you think both on Steam and [url=https://www.google.com/url?q=https://discord.com/invite/Nx6CmMNgrj&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1695897503990532&usg=AOvVaw0oC2zrSUHp9SUERjVm4RV8]Discord[/url].


[h2][b]CONTENTS OF THE DEMO[/b][/h2]

[b]The Chapter 2 Demo[/b] lets you jump into Urd’s shoes and [b]play the first out of 12 levels, test her arsenal and face new, fearsome enemies[/b]!

On top of that [b]you will be able to check out our new progression system[/b] which will let you replay the demo with different upgrades thanks to its randomisation! 

Here is the full list of content that you will be able to check in the demo:

notes.title: Road to Chapter 2 - Part 3: Wargression & Magic
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/cd4199eba4bc6242fd2a98a47fb9995cb25725c5.png[/img]

Hey Warlocks! 

We’re happy to be back with Part 3 of our Road to Chapter 2 series! In the previous updates we introduced Urd, showcased parts of her arsenal and teased some of the beautiful landscapes she will get to traverse, as well as meanies she will get to slaughter. 

Today’s article will focus on our fresh approach to the progression system and reveal the second part of Urd’s arsenal - her magical spells and abilities. Let’s jump straight into the details!
[hr][/hr]

[h3][b]WARGRESSION SYSTEM[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/42a1d4216e0b1aa09c2ceb0e2be5cd7b7444dd17.gif[/img]

During the development of Chapter 2 we were looking for ways of expanding the variety of your play-throughs and to better convey the agility and moment to moment gameplay as Urd. That lead us on the path to streamline the way she upgrades. Everything. Also - this should allow the players to experience more unique runs and speed up the progression process to stay in the action all the time!  

And this is what our [b]brand new Wargression system[/b] is all about. It is a variation of the first Project Warlock’s and Chapter 1’s Palmer’s system tailored specifically to the experience of playing Urd in Chapter 2.

In Chapter 2 instead of buying the upgrades from the stations located in the HUB, [b]you will be able to do it with Quick Buy Menu during your run[/b]. The menu will appear once an Upgrade Token is picked up and - in general - it will automatically roll 3 random upgrades to choose from. 

Playing as Urd you will be able to test and play around with all available upgrades and each play-through will guarantee its different combinations. You will be able to choose from [b]80 different upgrades spanned across 13 different categories[/b], each with a  varying number of upgrade levels. That’s 80 right now, but we’re still tweaking specific upgrades and will see if that number is enough. 

The upgrades available via Wargression System will significantly influence Urd’s arsenal on many different levels. For some weapons it will let you boost their accuracy, rate of fire, reload speed, extend ammo capacity or even increase the  chance to fire crystal projectiles! Certain upgrades will reduce the cooldowns for alternative fire and add additional effects to bullets, such as piercing or fire damage.

New progression will also influence how your attack, defense and magic works. It will improve the duration and performance of elemental effects like poison or frost or let you increase your health, armor and bleeding effect which you can inflict upon enemies. You will also get a chance to tweak the combo meter in numerous ways to feed your inner demons calling for high risk, high reward plays!

Even with a completely new approach to the progression the core Project Warlock II feature - the option to have deterministic builds - remains. To offer you more control over managing the progression of your builds we introduced the “Specialist Upgrade” (from the Luck category) narrowing down your option to 3 guaranteed categories of upgrades. You will also be able to use Reroll Tokens, Extra Roll Tokens and Luck Upgrades to manipulate the shop in a slight way to your advantage. 

You will also be able to track your active upgrades in the Status Menu, so you will be able to keep an eye on your build whenever you like.
[hr][/hr]

[h3][b]SPELLS AND SKILLS[/b][/h3]

It's a tradition for Project Warlock II to have guns and melee weapons accompanied by different sorts of spells or skills. That is why the witchcraft in possession of Urd goes a lot deeper than before into a wide range of useful and deadly spell techniques!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/ee4a827fc8df09ac4126022ac2869eff74fb7d86.gif[/img]

Do you want to feel the real vibe of being Warlock’s student? Spell book will let you release the mayhem with different types of spell attacks. When you pick it up for the first time, it will become a permanent addition to your arsenal. Just as if it were a regular weapon, you select it and then… - as the kids used to say - the real magic happens.

[b]Spell book[/b] lets you use five different spells, each with a different element attached. They are designed to suit Urd in various circumstances and to deal damage corresponding to specific monsters’ weaknesses.

With the spell book selected, [b]you will be able to turn its pages with the right mouse button[/b] to use spells based on fire, frost, poison, magic and crystal elements.
[hr][/hr]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/40897171072cda18fef12a1d70b4926908ce044d.gif[/img]

We already covered Dagger in our previous update. Suitable for the fast-paced gameplay style for Urd that might need to get painfully close to her enemies to dish out some personal damage, but she has another trick up her sleeve when it comes to this weapon.

Apart from the new addition of the spell book, Urd also has access to three different utility spells. Let’s check out [b]Dagger Storm[/b] first. [b]It creates a static tornado of flying Daggers[/b] damaging nearby monsters. Which makes it a good idea to conjure it in the middle of the demon horde. Until now, we let you dismember monsters with guns and blades, and used “meat grinder” as a metaphor - now you will be able to create a literal one!
[hr][/hr]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/4416fa3215d7a20d40cb0bbcd0de13bf00f760e5.gif[/img]

Having to spend all those years in exile would make everyone feel lonely. Urd’s no exception here. So what does she do? Having no friends around she… created one. Introducing: [b]Crystal Sentry - our first summoning spell in the game[/b]! 

Crystal Sentry follows the player and attacks monsters by [b]shooting powerful crystalline projectiles[/b]. It cannot be attacked by monsters, however each shot takes some health away from the Crystal Sentry until it breaks apart. Only to be summoned again a bit later, don’t worry!
[hr][/hr]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/31a5667161cd1d558d5660cc5e7d97c3fe3f5c20.gif[/img]

Next to the rich set of magical spells, Urd can also use one of the traditional tools but with a twist that will go hand in hand with her gameplay style - [b]the Poison Grenade[/b]. 

It will assist you in many different gameplay scenarios - whether you want to deal more damage to larger groups of enemies in the open area or throw it into the narrow passages to slow down some foes.

Poison grenade deals poisonous damage on explosion but also [b]affects your enemies with poison over time with the cloud that will emerge after the bang[/b].
[hr][/hr]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/d4ddb8a624200417ae2cc933f78858c70fd7104c.gif[/img]

To elevate Urd’s agility and spice up the gameplay with more useful maneuvering during battles we also implemented the [b]dash move[/b].

This is actually a special upgrade for the Dagger which allows more dynamic combat and bullet dodging! The dash has two upgradable stages - the first gives the ability to dash forward while attacking, the second lets you dash in all directions when Dagger is equipped.
[hr][/hr]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/56c1eec189feaed18d6f9ff65b84ebc9729573ad.gif[/img]

Lastly it is worth mentioning that Urd’s arsenal is not just your regular set of pistols and rifles. [b]Almost every weapon is infused with some magic[/b] which corresponds to the additional damage you deal to incoming monsters.

The main infusion in the set of weapons is Urd’s [b]crystal magic[/b] which supports the performance of SMG (upgrading it will give you a chance to fire crystal bullets) and Shotgun which features an alternative fire mode with deadly crystal shards. When it comes to the Dagger, it is magically infused [b]with poison as well as phantom slash attack upgrade[/b] - which gives the player a chance to deal a wide slash attack damaging multiple monsters.
[hr][/hr]

[h3][b]WHAT’S NEXT?[/b][/h3]

That’s all for the magical revelations today and at the same time we’re wrapping up the list of content for Chapter 2. 

Our team is still polishing various aspects of the new adventure as well as still improving the first chapter. In the next update we will explore this topic a little more, including various aspects from the original Project Warlock that return in the sequel. 

Till next time!

notes.title: Road to Chapter 2 - Part 1: New Character & Weapons
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/a95fd84d859f5ba7fe065ac2075d818356f1c496.png[/img]

[h3][b]💀 GLAD TO BE BACK![/b][/h3]

Hello, Warlocks! 

It’s been a long time since the last update and we do realize you are waiting for any bit of news regarding what's coming. Given the nature of some of the changes introduced to Chapter 1 after the game went into Early Access, we wanted to make sure we know fully well what we can commit to and deliver before actually announcing it. We do realize that the roadmap we published is a huge obligation so we spend as much time as we could to polish our vision of the new chapter. 

For the past months we have been working on Chapter 2 - [b]creating all the levels, monsters, weapons and a new system of upgrades first, and only moving to the polishing stage in the past couple of weeks[/b]. And today marks the moment where we feel confident to share information about Chapter 2 that you will get to play really soon. On top of that we also worked on what we aim to be [b]the final visual overhaul of Chapter 1[/b] that we want to share with you very very soon. Last but not least we have some [b]surprises for the fans of the original Project Warlock later this year[/b] to coincide with the 5th anniversary of the game’s release! 

Again - thank you for all your support along the way, all of your comments and precious feedback regarding the content we released so far - both for the positives and negatives. We take into account every comment and review to make sure we understand the expectations that you have for Project Warlock going forward. This doesn’t mean we can or will incorporate all of the suggestions. But it does help us make more informed decisions with what we have in store for you in the coming months. 

From today on [b]we will be posting weekly updates on Project Warlock II Chapter 2[/b] providing information on various changes incorporated into the game. We wanted to make sure that playing the fiery Urd will be a different experience than slaying demons as Palmer - thanks to numerous differences regarding the upgrade system, weapons and spells, arsenal and of course the setting. To kick it off properly we have prepared the first part of insights about the content that will come to Project Warlock II soon! 

So without further ado - let’s meet [b]Urd[/b], [b]the new character introduced in Chapter 2[/b], and learn a bit more about her arsenal.

[h3][b]💀 URD, THE MAGICAL GLASSCANNON[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/cf25775f845bb53ccf4024ee6524853547edb460.gif[/img]

[b]Banished by the master at a young age and left to die in a demonic dimension, Urd seeks revenge and will utilize every single tool at her disposal to get the job done[/b]. Her youngish looks - a result of the different flow of time in the land of her imprisonment - hide the powerful and explosive temper of a seasoned magic wielder.  

Playing as Urd you will take advantage of new sets of weapons and skills. The playstyle also differs in comparison to Palmer - Urd lacks physical strength of the Warlock disciple from Chapter 1, and [b]favors magical weapons infused with powerful crystals energy and powerful utility spells[/b] to obliterate those foolish enough to stand in her way. 

Urd’s arsenal is [b]small-caliber guns that go hand in hand with a very dynamic and more agile approach to combat[/b]. Also the way those guns can be upgraded varies from the tried and tested dual paths of development preferred by Palmer.


[h3][b]💀 CRYSTAL-POWERED ARSENAL[/b][/h3]

The weapons to take central stage today are - [b]the shotgun, the machine gun, the scoped pistol and a magical dagger[/b].


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/581d3064e6f2ec9d36859aa1cbd83f7f2c79b1d2.gif[/img]

[b]Urd’s dagger[/b] is suited for dishing damage both as a melee weapon and a projectile, with further enhancements to the magical blade that infuse it with various status effects, allow for homing in on the targets, spawn additional blades to throw simultaneously and other upgrades available on the go.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/a651562268eab912b25a9480902904ec7964c00c.gif[/img]

[b]Scoped pistol[/b] is powerful when shot from the hip, and devastating when using scope to land headshots from afar. And upgrading it allows for even more destructive power depending on the pick.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/5d35e56eb42f501afac56da8c446ec50cefd1d62.gif[/img]

In close quarters, you can use a [b]demon-infused shotgun[/b] hungry for successful shots and packing serious firepower to enemies that get too near. The only downside is the initially lengthy reload time, but that can be amended with the right upgrades. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/47b65aeb6b9161d84e73d7af33ba421d1fdda47e.gif[/img]

Finally - the [b]crystal-powered SMG[/b] is a reliable weapon, that gets more and more effective as you get better at timing your shots or bursts and eventually - enhance it with upgrades. It allows for a steady stream of bullets to welcome foes large and small in between choosing the next gun to finish the enemy at hand.  

Returning is the [b]Chapter 1 requested reload button[/b] for those that prefer their manual clip changing to that provided by the weapon swaps.


[h3][b]💀 MORE TO COME! [/b][/h3]

And that concludes today’s update. Over the next couple of weeks will share more about the nature of [b]the beasts[/b] that stand in Urd’s way, some [b]more info on the spells[/b] at her disposal, [b]the locales that she will travel through[/b] and a [b]revamped Wargression system that governs the upgrade system[/b] for our red-headed warlock. 

Stay tuned and follow our channels so you won’t miss new info! 


[b][h3]Join our Discord server![/h3][/b]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/Nx6CmMNgrj][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/a78f1f23a8d22ae43153eae9a1cd653789ccd347.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Welcome HUB
notes.content:
Hey Warlocks!

It’s time for another content update!

Today we're introducing something many of you are waiting for since the Early Access launch, [b]the HUB[/b]!

The original Project Warlock featured a Workshop HUB between levels, it was a place for the players to unwind after a tough encounter, upgrade their weapons, and level up their stats. We know you missed it in Project Warlock II, that's why [b]we're bringing it back[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/011c79a54b702e8fd65ad603424ec016db272ba0.jpg[/img]

The introduction of the HUB also changes the way all upgrade stations work, now they will grant [b]upgrade point tokens[/b] which can be collected and used for upgrades in the HUB.

We're also doubling down on character progression. Perks now require appropriate stat modifiers to be purchased. Just like in the original Project Warlock.

For all the collector out there, we haven't forgotten about you! The HUB contains a room with visual representation of collected bestiaries in form of monsters in capsules

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/48b0f363e8d0b075b897e463116a8ff5fb9b9790.jpg[/img]

[b]Here are the full patch notes[/b]:
[list]
[*] Upgrade stations are replaced with [b]upgrade point tokens[/b] which can be collected.
[*] Added [b]HUB[/b] between the levels with weapon upgrade, stat upgrade and perk upgrade stations.
[*] [b]Single Stage Catch Up[/b] - disabled upgrade stations in the levels.
[*][b] Added weapon upgrade cost[/b]. Weapon shop no longer disables on upgrade purchase.
[*][b] Added stat cost to each perk.[/b] To buy perks now you need appropriate stat modifier at a specific value.
[*] Improved monster sprites with reworked colouring and shading
[/list]

That would be it for today. We hope you enjoy the HUB, and all the features accompanying it. Make sure to let us know what you think!

As always, feel free to post feedback on the Steam forum, or our official [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]Discord server[/url]!

See you in the next one!

Buckshot Software and Retrovibe

notes.title: Perks & Stats-creation
notes.content:
Hey Warlocks!

It’s time for a content update!

We’ve heard your feedback regarding character progression, and ways to customize your playthroughs. We’re introducing 2 new ways to do so, by adding Perk and Stats Systems.

Those features should  spice up your playthroughs and make them more interesting. It should also give you an incentive to try out all of the combinations! And if you really like something you see, make sure to capture the moment with brand new Photo Mode!

[b]Keep in mind, that there is no save wipe, but for best experience with the new patch we recommend to start a New Game![/b]

We've also prepared an updated Roadmap. We've managed to put a check mark on all of the sticky notes planned for Chapter 1 and the work on the Chapter 2 is in full swing.  We're also looking at reworked Roadmap for 2023, so keep you eyes peeled!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/827f1f0c5757167ea4d308ff0766c1f4a5a43ece.png[/img]

Check out full patch notes:

[h3]Dambuster Perks[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/c3945ee8ddf4143bcd93a5df0eef4418a2dc423f.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Added Perk Shop. It is similar to Weapon upgrade shop as it can be found throughout the levels.
[*]Added collectible Perk Points. They can be found throughout the levels and are used to buy Perks.
[*]Added 10 new perks
[list]

[*] [b]Cold as Stone[/b] (1991) - Each cooldown token grants twice the cooldown value.
[*] [b]Fatal Affection[/b] (1987) - Attracts items from a small distance to the player.
[*] [b]Twin Hit[/b] (1991) - Increases ammo capacity by 1.5x
[*] [b]Phantom[/b] (1980) - Allows to move through enemies
[*] [b]Destruction Guy[/b] (1993) - Doubles the base combo time
[*] [b]Sharpshooter[/b] (1993) - Doubles the headshot damage
[*] [b]The Fast and the Late[/b] (1987) - Shortens weapon switch time
[*] [b]Marathon Dude[/b] (1987) - Increases maximum run speed
[*] [b]Deadly Gun[/b] (1986) - Removes max Akimbo duration, but cooldown duration is doubled
[*] [b]Mountaineer[/b] (1986) - Increases claymore swing speed and reduces stamina usage. 
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Stat Shop[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/5fe1dd79a048eddbffc93efd8cb4177261704344.png[/img]

Player stats are a new type of upgrade within the game. By collecting stat points, players can spend them in a stat station on increasing different damage efficiency types.

Those include:
[list]
[*] Melee damage efficiency
[*] Firearm damage efficiency
[*] Frost damage efficiency
[*] Fire damage efficiency
[*] Explosive damage efficiency
[/list]
[h3]Photo Mode[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/dc36477581302d374e5a984690c47a3b9aaa7a1f.png[/img]

Photo Mode is a new addition which allows the player to pause the game and take photos in real time while playing at any time. The time is stopped, and players can take pictures of the chaos at the moment of taking the picture.

There are multiple options:
[list]
[*]Mouse Mode and Camera Mode
[list]

[*] Mouse Mode enables Cursor and allows to change filters
[*] Camera Mode disables Cursor and allows the camera to move freely.
[/list]
[*]Game Logo Overlay (4 corners to pick from)
[*]Camera FOV
[*]Pixel Shader Filters
[*]CRT Filters
[*]Color Filters
[*]Color Correction
[/list]
That would be it for today. We hope you enjoy new features, and make sure to let us know how your playthroughs are going with the new systems!

As always, feel free to post feedback on the Steam forum, or our official [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]Discord server[/url]!

See you in the next one!

notes.title: Help us balance the new difficulty levels
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’re hard at work on implementing new difficulty levels to the game and we could use your help to make sure that they’re well-balanced and challenging.
 
[b]We plan to introduce four difficulty levels:[/b] Walk in the Park, Moderate Rumble, Come Get Some, and the most challenging Ready to Die. The main difference between them will be made through the number of enemies and their higher stats. Enemies will have more health, and resistance, and deal more damage to the player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/580f0dee6555cf4ecfd44c77f748b4662b7a417d.jpg[/img]

Before these new settings become part of Project Warlock II, you can check them out on a dedicated Beta branch and share your feedback in the comments or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1640300/discussions/0/3712685859921918649/]this forum thread[/url].
 
[h3]How can you join this playtest?[/h3]

Be sure to save your game first! Once you switch to the Beta branch, in-game autosaves will be overwritten, so [b]make sure to save your progress with a manual save option[/b].

In the Steam client, right-click on the game title, go to Properties, then to the Beta section, and select [b]difficulty_level_test - Difficulty Level Test Beta Branch[/b] from the expandable list. This will install the [b]build version 0.2.7.73[/b]. Start a new game and select one of four difficulty levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/4348e8257a7fa67a62a11d02c8447d7978e5f1a8.jpg[/img]

Once you’re done playing the Difficulty Level Test build, make sure to switch back from the beta branch to the main game branch in Steam’s properties. All game saves made during this playtest will be incompatible with the default game build, including autosaves!

The beta branch with the [b]Difficulty Level Test will stay active for the next two weeks, until December 27[/b]. We hope you’ll find some time to give it a try and share your feedback with us in the comments, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1640300/discussions/0/3712685859921918649/]in this forum thread[/url], or directly on [url=https://discord.com/invite/Nx6CmMNgrj]our official Discord[/url].

notes.title: Time to make a split
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

We’re happy to finally share with you this [b]major update for Chapter 1 of Project Warlock II[/b]. 

In this Level Patch (game version 0.2.7.51), we took the original six levels, split them, and rebuilt them into twelve completely revamped ones. They’re more streamlined, easier to navigate, and full of challenges. This wouldn’t be possible without your comments and feedback after playing the Early Access version and participating in our closed playtesting sessions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/0b8603c814367643c20ff48801d8d5cadeefba20.png[/img]

This patch also marks [b]a major shift in the direction in which we want to take Project Warlock II[/b]. 

Your feedback made it clear that there are some areas from the original Project Warlock that you miss quite a lot. This convinced us to not only look for new solutions but also try to bring back and expand the mechanics that we all enjoyed in the previous game. 

For example, we’re currently hard at work ironing out a perk system that will allow for bigger customization of your gameplay. These changes will have a significant impact on our roadmap and previously announced updates like reworking the weapons system. We’ll share an updated roadmap along with the next patch as it’s still under construction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/951b960894721283a7ac21e00c68b9f870b44aa2.png[/img]
[i]Work in progress look at the new Perk Shop   
[/i]

While Luke and Jerry are reworking, extending, and modifying the music to make it fit the new levels, we've already updated some tracks in this patch and added some new, unused tracks for you to listen to and make your play more fun. We're aiming at a tasteful combination of ambient and melody within each level's score. Please note that a major music rework update is yet to come!

For now, let’s get back to the Level Patch and have a look at [b]the list of levels in Chapter 1[/b]:

[b]E1M1[/b] - Siege of Palmer's Castle
[b]E1M2[/b] - The Obliterated Dungeons
[b]E1M3[/b] - Outskirts of the Munville Forest
[b]E1M4[/b] - The Fall of Darkville

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/6fc48c723fd3d56e4640290709f42667babfdf52.png[/img]
[i]New intro graphics for the levels
[/i]

12 levels now become our new standard and you can expect similar numbers in the upcoming Urd’s Redemption campaign and the yet untitled Chapter 3.

One more disclaimer is needed here. The original Level 5 didn’t meet your expectations and continuously underperformed in our internal playtests. It resulted in a decision to remove it from the game completely. We’ll yet to see if it returns in some shape or form in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/3900780b1402019dee87918a5890dd4d6fd39d02.png[/img]

[b]Please note that due to the changes to the structure of levels in the game, all previous game saves became incompatible with this and future versions of Project Warlock II Early Access![/b]

Below please find [b]the full changelog of the Level Patch[/b]:

GLOBAL CHANGES
[list]
[*] Split the existing levels into 12 levels
[*] Removed level 5 completely
[*] Overall navigation improvements
[*] Simplified level flow with a more linear level progress path
[*] More items spawn in every level
[*] Miniboss encounters are now much more frequent
[*] More big monster encounters
[*] Removed some of the monster spawners spawning behind the player but NOT ALL as it's a design choice in some places
[*] Enlarged a lot of areas to make the movement easier when fighting monsters
[*] Improved various particle effects
[*] Changed and added more music tracks
[/list]

ADDITIONS 
[list]
[*] Added new bestiary entries for elite monsters (Turbo Knight, Skeletron, Hogdaddy, Ubershambler)
[*] Added new secret cameos
[*] Added new entering graphics for each level
[*] Added new Lava Shader
[*] Added new Water Shader
[*] Added new Goo Shader
[*] Added new glowing material to destructible goo elements
[*] Added new 3D explosion effects and particles
[/list]

BALANCE 
[list]
[*] Improved Necrogirls resurrection logic - they will now run toward the resurrected monster
[*] Increased Skeletron projectile speed from 30m/s to 40m/s 
[/list]

BUGFIXES
[list]

[/list]

KNOW ISSUES (yet to be fixed)
[list]
[*] Ghouls at the tops of the pillars in E1M11 can get stuck even after aggroing the Player
[*] Minimap highlights blocked areas as reachable by the Player
[*] Projectiles of Laser Rifle's Railgun upgrade may be missaligned with the crosshair/gun model
[*] Monsters can be counted incorrectly in the intermission screen on some levels (up and down)
[*] Human NPC kills can count towards total monster kills counter
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/16a3daf3372f08946fc20b2c812ae291ae258978.png[/img]

Go and check the new and updated levels for yourself and be sure to share your thoughts on the forum and [url=https://discord.gg/ajW2HwxrX8]our official Discord[/url]! All feedback is welcome and most helpful in improving the game. 

Please [b]leave a Steam review if you enjoy the game[/b] as it helps us in reaching new players.

Also, don't miss our special [b]Boomer Shooter Friends Forever live stream on Tuesday, October 18[/b], at 12 PM PDT / 3 PM EDT / 9 PM CEST. Kuba Cisło, the creator of Project Warlock, YouTuber GmanLives, and host Jared R. Bair will talk about their favorite classic and modern shooters, the boomer shooter renaissance, and more. notes.title: New hotfix & Roadmap Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

We’ve released a hotfix that updates the game to [b]version 0.2.6.45[/b] and includes:
[list]
[*] A possible fix where sometimes the explosion VFX would not appear 
[*] Fixed a bug where monsters would aggro at the player too early 
[*] Added autosave-based checkpoints to the Single Stage mode
[/list]
Now you can continue to play your Single Stage run from the last checkpoint after you die on the map. It’s not possible to save, exit, and return to your run later on as they’re intended to serve as one-time only (erm, single) challenges that can be replayed on and on.

We also want to give you a quick development progress update. First, check out the [b]updated 2022 roadmap[/b]. We’re slowly putting more and more check marks on this board! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/8e66ff89aeef401c1d7dc118f86ee54c96b95674.png[/img]

We’re getting closer to a [b]major overhaul of the levels’ structure[/b]. We want to divide them into more, but smaller levels. The total scale and scope of the game will not change, but the flow of every single stage should be more natural and true to Project Warlock's roots. 

[b]Weapons tuning[/b] is another major update that the team has been working on. The basic weapons and both their upgrades and the way the system works will be revamped. The idea behind this update is to remove the feeling of choosing a "downgrade" instead of an upgrade (if you buy a specific upgrade that changes the weapon and you feel like it's not as cool as the base version). Also, we will be splitting weapon upgrades into weapon-specific and universal ones. It’s still early in the works, so your feedback will help us shape it further!

You can also expect Jerry and Luke, the guys behind the first Project Warlock’s OST, to continue their work on making sure that [b]Project Warlock II’s soundtrack is getting bigger and better[/b]. The division of the game's levels into smaller ones will result in additional tracks being added and will result in new tunes to accompany the pixelated slaughter.  

We’re also working our way up the ladder to share the info on [b]the second episode of Project Warlock I[/b]I - and can't wait to hear your thoughts on that!

Thank you to everyone who has already played the Early Access of Project Warlock II and please keep the feedback coming! Be sure to [b]leave a Steam review if you like the game[/b] and recommend us to your friends!

PS. We recently announced a special limited edition Big Box of the original Project Warlock made in cooperation with John Romero himself! Check it out below and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/893680/view/3405303823637108996]head over here[/url] for more details.

notes.title: Upcoming patch details, popular questions answered
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

New patch is playtested at this very moment, and will be available shortly. Below you’ll get a taste of what you can expect in that. Also - we pulled the most popular [b]Project Warlock II[/b] questions from Steam and [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]Discord[/url] and answered those here. 

Since we launched the Early Access version of [b]Project Warlock II[/b] we’ve received a ton of feedback from you, released a number of patches and fixes, as well as revealed our roadmap until the end of the year. And there’s still a lot more to come!

Some of the areas of the game we’re working on are:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/43631d720cc721a2a20c5296d5ca54da77cc5e96.jpg[/img]
[i]Totally redesigned saves system for clearer designation of all saved games, and limiting the number of manual saves and quicksaves[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/395c7299f648f038bf6c5be70b10e59ef3ef8c86.jpg[/img]
[i]Introducing Single Stage mode for revisiting previously completed levels[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/8fd9bcf81af2b9897da3e18f9a76927c175bb20d.jpg[/img]
[i]Adding more pronounced audio and visual cues to enemy demons spawning in[/i]

That and a whole variety of balances, fixes and adjustments across the board that will be fully outlined in the upcoming patch update.  

Each and every suggestion or a bit of feedback provided by you makes its way to our internal database and is reviewed case-by-case. When we said we want to shape the game according to your feedback, we meant it. 

It’s not always possible to respond to all messages or comments and some of them might tackle topics that we’re already aware of and work on, so we’ve prepared this handy list of responses and updates about some of the most frequent topics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/55a53b738addb565575dd6503504be8b4bf6894d.gif[/img]

[b]1:[/b] There’s a lot of clutter on the screen - specifically cooldown reduction orbs, ammo, health, and armor, but also some environment elements sometimes make it hard to see what’s happening on the screen. Are you planning to address that?

[b]ANSWER:[/b] In one of the upcoming patches (coming: soon) we’re reducing the number of dropped items. We’re also repositioning some of the trees as they have been reported to obscure enemies, who (being vicious demons from hell) predictably used that to their advantage. 

[b]2:[/b] Enemies are sometimes getting stuck in walls, trees, pillars, and other elements of the environment. What gives?

[b]ANSWER:[/b] These issues are two-fold. One - after one of the redesigns of the levels, some of the enemies seemed to be stuck in walls with their spawners. Two - some of the doors and breakable passageways cause enemies to behave strangely. The placement issue has been resolved in the latest hotfix patch as well as the enemies getting stuck.

[b]3:[/b] Why are some enemies shooting through the walls?

[b]ANSWER:[/b] This was an issue with misplaced spawners of some monsters. It has now been resolved in the latest  hotfix.

[b]4:[/b] Enemies are getting stuck in the floor - mostly in E1M5.

[b]ANSWER:[/b] This issue has been addressed in the latest patch, we’ve modified the size of the space with problematic floor material.

[b]5:[/b] Sometimes the player character gets stuck on the stairs, slopes, and walls.

[b]ANSWER:[/b] That was an issue with the Player controller and has now been resolved in the latest hotfix. Special thanks to those who attached images or videos of problematic spots in their feedback posts. You know who you are, and we know not all of you wear capes!

[b]6:[/b] The enemies spawning behind the player after picking up every key/weapon/spell are a problem.

[b]ANSWER:[/b] The upcoming patch has more pronounced visual and audio cues to make the monsters spawning in more noticeable as per the screen on top of this post. That same upcoming patch will also result in a do-over regarding the monster spawn placements. The aim is to eradicate those instances that feel unfair to the player by not giving ample time to react. 

[b]7:[/b] The levels are bigger than in the original [b]Project Warlock[/b], which makes them difficult to navigate through and it’s very easy to get lost and wander in circles.

[b]ANSWER:[/b] We’re looking at the scope of the levels and making sure they are more accessible. One thing that emerged from the playtest and subsequent feedback is that we will be going for a division of the levels into smaller and more approachable areas. This is coming in the future.

[b]8:[/b] Some of the secrets are too hard to find.

[b]ANSWER:[/b] Well… yes and no. We believe that most of the secrets aren’t that problematic and are well-indicated, whether by a red target mark, a button, or a destructible wall. But we’ve heard a lot of voices. In the previous point, we’ve mentioned redesigning the levels. We believe it will help this issue as the levels will be smaller and secrets should become easier to find. 

Also, the Single Stage Mode (coming in the next content patch) will allow players to jump between levels to find secrets they’ve missed.

[b]9:[/b] Are more game modes coming to [b]PW2[/b]?

[b]ANSWER:[/b] Yes. Single Stage mode is now being extensively tested and will be a part of the next content patch. Stars of one of the future updates - the Mutators will also have a significant impact on the way you play the game.

[b]10:[/b] The music in [b]Project Warlock II[/b] feels repetitive and just not that good, whereas it was one of the best things in the original [b]Project Warlock[/b].

[b]ANSWER:[/b] Jerry and Luke - the guys behind the first [b]Project Warlock[/b]’s OST are hard at work on making sure that [b]Project Warlock II[/b]’s soundtrack is as memorable - or waaaay more - as that of the first game. The issue with the tracks right now is that the concept for dynamic music that was originally in place had to be reconsidered. It just didn’t work that well and was changed. Currently, some of the tracks might need that extra ooomph, but that's because most of them are devoid of their more dynamic, combat parts. There will be new tracks, as we’re working on the [b]PW2[/b] soundtrack to hit the bar we’ve set with the original game. Adding the tracks as well as dividing the levels into smaller parts should reduce the feeling of repetitiveness. 

[b]11:[/b] The loading times in [b]Project Warlock II[/b] seem excessively long, what’s going on?

[b]ANSWER:[/b] We’ve got a two-part fix planned for this. First, in one of the upcoming patches, we’re improving the overall optimization of the levels. Secondly, the loading times will be shorter once we divide the levels. There’s also a topic of the overabundance of saves that also has an impact on this. Upcoming patch addresses that by limiting the number of manual and quicksaves and also by redesigning the save menu. 

One important thing to note here, though. The upcoming patch will render all the saves up until that point useless. So if you want to finish up that playthrough with your current save - now's the right time.    

[b]12:[/b] Some of the weapons and their upgrades feel lackluster.

[b]ANSWER:[/b] Weapon tuning is one of the major updates that the team has been working on for the past couple of months. It will require quite a bit of testing so we have no timeframe to give, but this will be happening very soon. If you'd like to give it a go - please apply for a playtesting role on our [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]Discord[/url] to participate.

In the Weapon update basic weapons and both their upgrades and the way the system works will be revamped. For example, instead of upgrading the Rifle into the Heavy Rifle, you’ll be able to add an additional barrel, sight and ammo capacity. This will result in a chance to expand the capacities of a particular weapon more significantly than just with a short upgrade tree. As we said, it’s early in the works, so your feedback will help us shape it further!

[b]13:[/b] The automap is hard to read, any plans to address that?

[b]ANSWER:[/b] In the upcoming patch, we’ll adjust the minimap’s height colors. More specifically by removing Red and Green height differences, making uncovered terrain white and covered terrain dark gray. This will help you navigate through the levels and find areas you haven’t explored yet. We’ll continue to closely monitor your feedback to make sure we get it right.

[b]14:[/b] When can we expect more levels?

[b]ANSWER:[/b] New levels are coming in the second episode. We don’t have a specific time frame yet, but you can check out our roadmap for 2022 below. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/0e79ec91ccf680d117484788711e35673f6febb3.png[/img]

Thanks for being here with us and look out for the incoming patch!

notes.title: Watch your steps
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Here’s a changelog for our latest hotfix that updates the game to [b]version 0.2.5.43[/b] where we address some often occurring inconveniences: 
[list]
[*] Improved Player controller stepping - players should no longer get stuck on certain geometry objects 
[*] Fixed spawn points of monsters resulting in them shooting through walls from inaccessible areas
[/list]

We’re working hard on a big content and balancing patch next. It will address a lot of your requests and add new content, including the Single Stage mode, and more. These changes, however, will have consequences: 

[h2]Starting with our next update, all game saves will become incompatible with new versions of Project Warlock II![/h2]

It’s a necessary downside of how the game’s structure is changing during the Early Access. 

We recommend that you complete your current playthroughs before the next update. We’ll also give you an option to play the older version of the game on a separate game branch for some time. 

Please have in mind that the game is still under development. We appreciate that you’re part of this process and help us make Project Warlock II a better game with your constant feedback. We also want to give a bit of a heads up - similar game saves incompatibilities might continue to occur during our Early Access but we’ll try to keep those to a minimum.

Hey everyone!

[b]Thank you very much for all the feedback[/b] and please find the first wave of fixes, changes, and tweaks. Some of them add requested features (looking at you, Reload) and enemy nerfs (sorry, Necrogirl) that are generally rebalancing the game. Others fix some outstanding issues.  


We’re already hard at work on the next batch of improvements that you suggested on Steam forums and on Discord and will continue to do so.

[*] Added option of closing the tutorial with interaction

[*] Added an error message on game start if there are any issues with IO access to folders to avoid the game being stuck at the logo screen

[*] Added 180-degree rotation Binding for controllers

[list]

[/list]

Next to fixing glitches and bugs encountered on your playthroughs, [b]the first big improvement next in line is the weapons rebalancing and modifications[/b]. We want to offer deeper customization options for the guns allowing you to upgrade your favorite tools of destruction further. 

We will share more details on the upcoming plans and an Early Access roadmap soon.

notes.title: Project Warlock II Kickstarter update
notes.content:
With just 5 days left, the [b]Project Warlock II[/b] Kickstarter campaign is entering its final phase. We thought it would be a perfect moment to update you on the progress the backers have made so far. And maybe you'll find something to your liking as well. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/2f4329cb9b27a3f01fc7bc46a5e9c6bae5ee67f1.png[/img]

In the last 3 weeks, more than 830 backers pledged over €26.000. We would like to thank all the backers for their immense support and love for our game.

This is the last week of the campaign, so if you would like to join us on this wonderful journey head to: 

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/project-warlock-2/project-warlock-2

Backers who support the game can get the "Backer" role on the Retrovibe Discord channel, Digital Early Access key for Steam, and - depending on the pledge level - can also receive additional items, such as: a boxed version of Project Warlock II. 

Right now 175 copies of the physical Project Warlock II found their owners, which means that the €50 Flap Box will contain additional items such as:
- a thicker manual,
- a sticker,
- a 32 page colour artbook,
- a collector’s pin,
- an 8GB Laser Rifle Pendrive

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/9f75247172546a3702ccfe1f30b2f3263bdb0493.png[/img]

Now the item that's still waiting to be unlocked is the Steel Book that needs 20 extra copies of the Boxed Edition sold. And this is what it looks like from up close. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/5e0df8460e7d33dfba56c5eddbccb2e88ca17743.png[/img]

On top of the unlocked contents of the Box Edition of [b]Project Warlock II[/b] there's also a couple of items you can order separately. 

The three available are:

- A [b]Project Warlock II[/b] themed mousepad 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/3366b151ed4905487cd76883e635d70d214d89d6.jpg[/img]

- A [b]Project Warlock II[/b] Hardcover Artbook

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/5c294b3977000f59d8b0723b4db30a196e3322ee.jpg[/img]

- A terrifying Shambler 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/ba16a429baeb28e468f89b2fd03033c76acb4e6b.jpg[/img]

Apart from physical rewards, we invite the most generous backers to help us design various elements of the game, such as spells, guns, monsters, and even a Warlock and a level in the PWII. Those rewards are limited, and some of them are no longer available (shoutout to those who decided to show such an immense amount of support!).

So what can you design in [b]Project Warlock II[/b]?

How about one of the spells in the game?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/29462b6a20a66ba5f9919f3dab8906a8f29920ff.jpg[/img]

Not really in the mood? Prefer to have a hand in creating something more substantial? How about...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/0832ea43dce4a5fd97b3283393680c999a5e19b5.jpg[/img]

Now let’s talk about stretch goals we’ve set to show our appreciation to all of you, and we decided to add new features to [b]Project Warlock II[/b] with each goal.

At €10.000 the Extra Narrative Illustrations reward was unlocked, meaning that you will see additional inter-mission artwork during your playthroughs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/b1fb08fac350da37d2ffbe201477ded85e2e3fa7.jpg[/img]

At €20.000 Alternate Weapon Skins for the Warlocks’ arsenal were unlocked. This will give you a chance to swap around weapon skins and make every playthrough feel a little bit different.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/f08e0ca26c30d8b6502d0f9777e25ff13928bb15.jpg[/img]

At €25.000 you unlocked Enemy Boss Voice Overs, which will add an extra depth of immersion to our game. We already have amazing ideas, and we can’t wait to get to work on the voicelines!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/cd74dfc677aeb743fb61fb545d2c3fe4e14ad716.jpg[/img]

As for further goals we have Photo Mode, Extra Enemy Variants and Arena Mode as well. 

We would, once again, like to thank all of the backers for the support, and the trust placed in us. The work on the game is well underway and we hope that you will love the game once it launches. The Kickstarter campaign might be coming to an end, but it’s only the beginning for [b]Project Warlock II[/b].

notes.title: Weekend at Warlock's
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

This was a busy week for [b]Project Warlock II[/b], as we're nearing the moment where you will be able to play the game. Between working on the current build of the game and fixing bugs that tend to appear in soon to be released games, rethinking certain design choices thanks to supportive friends (hey, Dave!), working on the demo (what DEMO?), and finishing marketing activities we also took part in certain initiatives that you guys might find interesting  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/eba761182463e4b1a4bf373519b12bf7205e8693.jpg[/img]

1.	[b]Realms Deep 2021 event [/b]

[b]Project Warlock II[/b] was featured as a part of the #RD2021 event, where we debuted a gameplay video alongside 160 other excellent retro-themed games. This was also the first time ever we showcased a longer section of gameplay with no image and sound manipulation. So - the gameplay you see is taken from the actual build of the game dating around three weeks' ago (submission date). In the gameplay below you can see footage from Episode 3, halfway into Palmer’s adventure. You will be able to see spells in action, a lot of shooting and enemies that get bisected, blown to bits, shotgun-beheaded and filled with lead in their full pixelated glory. We aimed to show the game in it’s full on balls to the top action mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/dfdc7662420141cc0236bf1b2ae5e4f47c1ac9b3.png[/img]

2.	[b]Collector's Edition[/b]

That was the moment where we announced - amongst other things - [b]Project Warlock II[/b]'s Collector’s edition that's available right now. This is something you can get your hands on provided you like kicking things that are starting. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723470/9f75247172546a3702ccfe1f30b2f3263bdb0493.png[/img]

3.	[b]First ten minutes @IGN[/b]

On Sunday an exclusive preview of the first level in action (first ten minutes) aired on IGN showing the slightly tweaked version of the first level. Tweaked as in – having a Hard level amount of enemies with Standard difficulty level behaviour and health levels. The game is still in testing phases, but you can see the way [b]Project Warlock II[/b] currently plays. You can check out environments, gunplay, an upgrade and different effects showing the game in action. Played by no-one other than Kuba - @PWarlock_dev himself. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KI9tciXbcTY

4.	[b]Realm Deep 2021 The Vault video[/b]

Released after the actual Realms Deep event as a part of the in-depth videos filled section see below the video where Kuba takes you through the development of [b]Project Warlock II[/b]. This is a part of a larger collection of videos alongside other games in Realm Deep's website section of The Vault.  

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3lD2VmA5PsM

And that's... just the beginning. Watch this space for more!
